The separate send-to window is gone for good, and the popup got its duplicate line and its spacing sorted.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Nothing ever opens a window of its own any more.** The separate send-to window is deleted outright, not just avoided: when the browser will not open the toolbar popup by itself, the send stays parked and the toolbar icon carries a mark saying something is waiting — opening the popup then shows it. A fallback window kept sneaking back in on exactly the attempts where the popup could not open, which is the one moment nobody expects a new window.
- **The duplicate line under the heading is gone.** The popup named the current page in a line of its own, which on most pages restated the button underneath and on KnightLoader's own pages repeated the heading word for word. It only appears now when it carries something nothing else says: a caught Click'n'Load batch, or a right-clicked link waiting for a choice.
- **One vertical rhythm.** The gaps between the cards, the send button and the window edge were three different values; they are one now, and the always-empty status line no longer reserves space for messages it was not showing.
- **The card-section badges match BombVault's, measured, not assumed.** They rendered four pixels taller with smaller text: the box was content-box (so the padding grew it past its own height) and an oversized info icon pushed it further, while the label sat at 11px instead of 12. Both apps now produce the same 22px badge with the same 12px label — verified against a live BombVault in the same browser on the same evening.

## 📋 Notes

- Five strings belonging to the deleted window left all 42 locales, one new one arrived (the "a send is waiting" tooltip on the toolbar mark), and the line naming the current page dropped its now-unused fallback text.
